title: Release a named-selection hold when its report is already proven durable at acknowledgement
outcome: An exact report-row readback at the acknowledged snapshot cut avoids an unnecessary wait through delivery backoff.
acceptance: A regression places an exact durable predecessor report in delivery backoff and verifies the acknowledged successor can proceed without waiting for another network-delivery attempt.
Successor release still requires exact durable report content or the predecessor's own terminal outcome and never changes immutable report bytes.
